attempts.patch:
--- a/src/repair.py
+++ b/src/repair.py
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 def repair(items):
     result = []
     for start, end in sorted(items):
-        if result and start < result[-1][1]:
+        if result and start <= result[-1][1]:
             result[-1][1] = max(result[-1][1], end)
         else:
             result.append([start, end])

review.summary: Accept. Changing the overlap comparison to <= correctly merges closed intervals that share an endpoint, including chained merges. Sorting continues to support unsorted input without modifying it, and newly allocated result intervals avoid mutating input intervals. Empty-input behavior and output ordering remain unchanged. The patch modifies only the permitted source file and is narrowly scoped. Reported tests and static checks pass with no regressions; only two tests are reported, so coverage is limited, but the change directly implements the required boundary semantics.

review.summary: Accept. The patch correctly compares numeric segments by stripping leading zeros, comparing digit counts, then comparing equal-length digit strings. This avoids numeric precision limits, preserves missing-segment-as-zero behavior, and returns only -1, 0, or 1. Changes are narrowly scoped to an existing source file. Supplied test and static reports both exit successfully, with no reported regressions; individual test assertions were not provided.

benchmarks.title: Merge touching intervals
benchmarks.issue: Merge sorted or unsorted closed intervals, including intervals that share an endpoint. Do not mutate the input.

benchmarks.title: Honor zero weights
benchmarks.issue: Return the weighted mean of (value, weight) pairs. Zero weights contribute nothing. Reject a nonpositive total weight with ValueError.

benchmarks.title: Keep the final partial page
benchmarks.issue: Split values into pages of size n. Retain a partial final page. Reject n <= 0 with ValueError.

benchmarks.title: Expire at the deadline
benchmarks.issue: Return keys whose expiration time is strictly later than now. A key expires exactly at its deadline; preserve insertion order.

benchmarks.title: Match Unicode identifiers
benchmarks.issue: Group identifiers case-insensitively using Unicode casefold after NFC normalization. Preserve the original strings and insertion order in each group.

benchmarks.title: Retain zero-value ledger entries
benchmarks.issue: Return entries with a non-null amount. Zero is a valid amount. Do not mutate entries or drop negative adjustments.

benchmarks.title: Compare numeric version segments
benchmarks.issue: Compare dotted numeric version strings. Return -1, 0 or 1. Missing segments are zero; compare segments numerically, not lexicographically.

benchmarks.title: Respect an empty queue capacity
benchmarks.issue: Return up to capacity values from the start. Capacity zero returns no items, and negative capacity raises RangeError.

benchmarks.title: Advance dates across month boundaries
benchmarks.issue: Given an ISO UTC date, return the ISO UTC date the next day. Handle month, year and leap-day boundaries without using local time.

benchmarks.title: Keep the newest duplicate record
benchmarks.issue: Deduplicate records by id, retaining the last value for each id. The order of ids follows their first appearance. Do not mutate input.

benchmarks.title: Keep a trailing chunk
benchmarks.issue: Split items into chunks of positive integer size. Keep a partial final chunk and reject zero, negative or fractional sizes with RangeError.

benchmarks.title: Divide a partial window correctly
benchmarks.issue: Return a trailing moving average for each position using up to window items. Divide by the available item count in the initial partial windows. Reject nonpositive or fractional windows.
